meaning.en: A tree (Diospyros kaki) native to China, widely cultivated for its large edible fruit, having orange to reddish skin, orange flesh, and an enlarged, persistent calyx.
meaning.vi: Một loài cây (Diospyros kaki) có nguồn gốc từ Trung Quốc, được trồng rộng rãi để lấy quả to ăn được, có da màu cam đến hơi đỏ, thịt màu cam và đài hoa to, dai.

sentences.en: The ethanol extraction conditions of flavonoids from leaves of diospyros kaki and their antioxidant activities were studied simultaneously.

sentences.en: The best extraction conditions for the extraction of total flavonoids by microwave-assisted extraction technique from Diospyros kaki leaf was investigated.
